newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore paramedics oppose privatization effort.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore paramedics oppose privatization effort.

text.p: Baltimore City firefighters and paramedics staged a demonstration at City Hall Monday protesting a proposal to privatize the city's ambulance service.
The demonstration came after reports that the city solicited bids to take over the function, which is now part of the fire department.
The paramedics argued that quality of care will deteriorate if the ambulances are taken over by a private company concerned with making a profit.
City officials said the present cost of running the service, $8 million annually, is too high.
